# `speed_move_ratio`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Set the per-camera pixel scale and derive the speed-move ratio used for scope_speed_move.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build matches (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, guider handler @0x7e1d0 (64-bit build); ratio computation @0x7e580 |

Params is an object with cam_id (0 or 1), pix_scale and sel_wide_cam, all required. pix_scale is stored for the camera slot immediately, so a later failure (for example 300 from an invalid scale pair) leaves the new scale in place. With sel_wide_cam false the ratio becomes -1; with it true the ratio is computed from the stored tele and wide scales. The stored values feed scope_speed_move at level 0 or below. No camera-selection SDK call is made. This is also the method an imager sends to the guider on reconnect.

Side effects: Writes the global per-camera pixel scale table and the global speed-move ratio.

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 104 | cam_id missing or not an integer | `expected int param` |
| 300 | cam_id outside 0..1, or sel_wide_cam true with invalid or sentinel stored scales | `internal error` |
| 108 | pix_scale missing or not a number | `expected float param` |
| 106 | sel_wide_cam missing or of a type other than boolean or integer | `expected bool param` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request is not an object, is an empty object, or has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: no method of type string (a non-string method counts as missing) | `invalid request` |
| 101 | Dispatcher: text fails to parse | `invalid JSON request: <reason> on line <n> ...` |
| 103 | Dispatcher: unregistered method | `method not found` |

Valid pixel-scale ranges and the full prerequisites of the true branch for all models are unresolved.
